title: Version 4.2 Release Notes
paragraphs: Star Cloud, our productivity application, has a new version available today. Please install the update on both desktop and mobile devices to access the latest improvements.

This release includes a security patch that fixes a login issue reported by several users last month. We also made your files update between devices faster, so changes now appear in the cloud almost instantly.
The dashboard now has a fresh design. It shows clearer charts and a new notification center. You can now choose which alerts appear, and turn off ones you do not need.
If you experience any problem after the update, contact our support team through the help menu inside the app.
